title.suggested: Allen backs Sullivan and heads to New Orleans

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen, who had backed Mitchell and Kilrain against John L. Sullivan, would now back Sullivan, and would leave for New Orleans the next Sunday with his old backer Fred Watkins.

metadata.notes: No page image to check the masthead; date and paper taken from the source file name (St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Mon., Aug. 29, 1892).

facts.fact: Allen planned to leave St. Louis for New Orleans on Sunday morning to see the fights there, with his old backer Fred Watkins, Billy Dacre, Tom Riley, 'Nobby' Clarke and Chris Louff
Allen backed John L. Sullivan in his coming championship fight, having backed Charlie Mitchell at Chantilly and Jake Kilrain at Richburg against Sullivan
Charlie Mitchell was one of Allen's particular friends

notes: Travel date is 'next Sunday' after Monday Aug. 29 (Sept. 4, 1892), a planned trip; medium confidence. Related to the unnumbered facts-index entry about Allen returning from a New Orleans fight in early September 1892.
